finding: Primary quotation provenance is broadly present, but the explanatory/grammar layer is under-referenced. A local sourceId often proves the quoted text but does not by itself prove the grammatical or historical explanation.
remediation: Create a global grammar/curriculum reference registry.
Add referenceIds to every learning block and every exercise explanation.
Add referenceIds to lesson-level grammar/framework objects, casePanel, authoringPolicy and checkpoints.
Allow referenceIds to resolve to either lesson-local primary sources or global registry references.
Reject unresolved or empty explanation references in CI.
Do not add unverified page numbers.
